memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis: persistent sneezing, nasal congestion, worse in mornings. Status: active. Plan: start cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS; advise avoidance of dust, keep windows closed; review in 3 months.
- Iron-deficiency anaemia: fatigue, mild pallor. Status: active. Plan: start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD with breakfast; check CBC, ferritin, MCV, skin prick test, total IgE; review in 3 months.
- Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm, slightly increased). Diet: breakfast - whole grain toast with egg; lunch - rice, dal, vegetables; dinner - light soup, chapati; avoid junk.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Allergic rhinitis – allergy to house dust mite. Reaction: sneezing, nasal itching, clear rhinorrhea on exposure. Documented for avoidance and treatment planning.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Started cetirizine at night; less daytime sneezing but some nasal congestion remains. Fluticasone spray causes mild throat irritation. Ferrous sulfate causes constipation; taking with water and fiber helps a bit. Montelukast no side effects noticed.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis: symptoms improved, occasional congestion. Status: active but controlled. Plan: continue cetirizine HS, fluticasone OD, consider tapering montelukast if symptoms stay mild.
- Iron-deficiency anaemia: Hb up to 11.2 g/dL, ferritin 28 ng/mL. Status: improving. Plan: change ferrous sulfate to 200 mg on alternate days; repeat CBC and ferritin in 6 weeks.
- Weight 67 kg, waist 82 cm (still slightly above cutoff). Diet advice: breakfast - oats with milk; lunch - mixed veg rice; dinner - dalia, curd.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-10-10.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis: well controlled, only occasional mild congestion. Status: active, controlled. Plan: stop montelukast; continue cetirizine HS and fluticasone OD; review in 4 months.
- Iron-deficiency anaemia: Hb 12.4 g/dL, ferritin 45 ng/mL. Status: resolved. Plan: stop ferrous sulfate; advise iron-rich diet; check CBC in 3 months to ensure stability.
- Weight 66 kg, waist 80 cm (at cutoff). Diet: maintain balanced meals, reduce refined carbs.
- Due: HbA1c 2026-01-02.
